---
title: "What level-flight top speed does the 3S powertrain reach?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 62.2      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Solved top speed and performance at nominal 3S (11.1 V open circuit)
top_perf = find_top_speed(airplane, mass=MASS_AUW, v_oc=11.1)
v_top_kmh = top_perf["v_top_kmh"]
v_top_ms = top_perf["v_top"]

# Performance at claimed top speed
v_claim_kmh = 87.0
v_claim_ms = v_claim_kmh / 3.6
d_claim = level_flight_drag(airplane, v_claim_ms, mass=MASS_AUW)
prop_claim = solve_propulsion_thrust(v_claim_ms, v_oc=11.1)
t_claim = prop_claim["thrust"]
t_to_d_claim = t_claim / d_claim
speed_margin_pct = (v_top_kmh - v_claim_kmh) / v_claim_kmh * 100

# Propeller pitch speed at full-throttle top speed RPM
prop_pitch_in = 4.5
v_pitch_kmh = (top_perf["rpm"] / 60.0) * (prop_pitch_in * 0.0254) * 3.6

# Airspeed sweep for thrust-drag curve
v_sweep = np.linspace(10.0, 48.0, 20)
drag_sweep = np.array([level_flight_drag(airplane, v, mass=MASS_AUW) for v in v_sweep])
thrust_nom = np.array([solve_propulsion_thrust(v, v_oc=11.1)["thrust"] for v in v_sweep])
thrust_sag = np.array([solve_propulsion_thrust(v, v_oc=10.0)["thrust"] for v in v_sweep])
thrust_fresh = np.array([solve_propulsion_thrust(v, v_oc=12.0)["thrust"] for v in v_sweep])
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{v_top_kmh:.1f} km/h"`]{.hero-value}
[Level-flight top speed on 3S LiPo at nominal 11.1 V]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Yes. The [reconstructed airframe](2026-10-02-01-does-the-reconstructed-airframe-reproduce-published-wing-loading-and-s.qmd) reaches [`{python} f"{v_top_kmh:.1f} km/h"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{v_top_ms:.1f} m/s"`]{.key}), exceeding the claimed [`{python} f"{v_claim_kmh:.0f} km/h"`]{.key} by [`{python} f"{speed_margin_pct:+.0f}%"`]{.key}. At [`{python} f"{v_claim_kmh:.0f} km/h"`]{.key}, level-flight drag is [`{python} f"{d_claim:.2f} N"`]{.key} while the powertrain supplies [`{python} f"{t_claim:.2f} N"`]{.key} thrust—a [`{python} f"{t_to_d_claim:.1f}×"`]{.key} excess requiring partial throttle. Top speed is limited by the [`{python} f"{prop_pitch_in:.1f}-inch"`]{.key} pitch speed ([`{python} f"{v_pitch_kmh:.0f} km/h"`]{.key} at [`{python} f"{top_perf['rpm']:.0f} RPM"`]{.key}) rather than airframe drag (@fig-thrust-drag).

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **motor parameters: 75 mOhm, 0.9A**, typical 2205.
2. **battery and ESC resistance: 70 mOhm**, typical 3S pack.
3. **propeller polar: APC 6x4.5**, thin electric empirical fit.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-thrust-drag
#| fig-cap: "Available thrust across battery states and level-flight drag versus airspeed."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.0))

v_sweep_kmh = v_sweep * 3.6
ax.plot(v_sweep_kmh, drag_sweep, "k-", lw=2, label="Level flight drag ($L = W$)")
ax.plot(v_sweep_kmh, thrust_nom, "b-", lw=2, label="Thrust: 3S nominal (11.1 V)")
ax.plot(v_sweep_kmh, thrust_sag, "b--", lw=1.2, alpha=0.7, label="Thrust: 3S loaded sag (10.0 V)")
ax.plot(v_sweep_kmh, thrust_fresh, "b:", lw=1.2, alpha=0.7, label="Thrust: 3S fresh pack (12.0 V)")

ax.plot(v_top_kmh, top_perf["thrust"], "ro", ms=6, label=f"Top speed ({v_top_kmh:.1f} km/h)")
ax.axvline(v_claim_kmh, color="gray", linestyle="--", lw=1, label=f"Claimed speed ({v_claim_kmh:.0f} km/h)")

ax.set_xlabel("Airspeed [km/h]")
ax.set_ylabel("Force [N]")
ax.set_xlim(30, 175)
ax.set_ylim(0, 8.5)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
